text:
olivia: Hey team — opened a PR to standardize export examples and SOC2 wording across the docs site. Includes new C# snippet and a sample JSONL shape for exports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1320

ben: Link?

olivia: ^ there. Changes: replace 'TTL' with 'retention period' in public pages, add explicit note that deletion == 'deleted from active storage' (backup parenthetical added), remove hard-coded API keys from examples, and add C# + jq transform samples.

tasha: I'll take the C# example. We should show async streaming pattern for large exports.

riley: I'll add a jq transform to pseudonymize actor emails in the sample. Legal wants us to avoid full emails in exports by default.

legal: Please use this phrasing: "Records will be deleted from active storage; archival copies may persist per our backup policy." Also add a short sentence recommending pseudonymization (hash or truncate) for exported identifiers. Avoid promises about immediate backup purging.

olivia: Good wording, thanks. Tasha/Riley, can you include <API_KEY> placeholders and a one-liner for ISO duration examples (e.g., P30D)?

tasha: Pushed C# snippet to the PR: ```csharp
var client = new RedwoodClient("<API_KEY>");
await foreach (var line in client.Audit.ExportAsync(scope: "account", retention: "P30D"))
{
    Console.WriteLine(line);
}
```

riley: Added jq pseudonymize transform example to PR: ```bash
cat export.jsonl | jq -c '.actor_email |= (sha256 | .[0:12])' > export_pseudonymized.jsonl
```

linkchecker-bot: PR #1320 linkcheck: found redirect /sdk/csharp -> /sdk/dotnet/quickstart. CI: https://ci.redwood/links/1320

olivia: Fixing links and applying the legal phrasing exactly. Also replacing any remaining sample tokens with `<API_KEY>` and updating the JSONL sample schema in the doc.

ben: Small nit: change example header 'Authorization: Token' -> 'Authorization: Bearer' in curl examples.

olivia: Good catch — updated. docs-bot: any other checks?

docs-bot: docs-bot: all lint and link checks passing for PR #1320

olivia: Merged. I'll add a changelog note and loop in support so they know exported files will be pseudonymized by default unless contract states otherwise. Thanks all :tada:
